iteration_semantics: Initial planning cycle is the cycle containing the first actual scheduled work segment. Iteration is a single active planning assignment, not a guarantee that the whole Issue finishes within this cycle. Exact work per cycle derives from existing segments.
rationale: Keep 3 nearest weekly iterations in GitHub now, matching the first 3 of 5 documented cycles. Later 2 remain calendar context until next rolling planning update.
Use iteration:@current for Current sprint; initial board matches 12–18 November. Work scheduled in this cycle includes early preparation for larger cards.

At each review, close only actually completed work. For unfinished cards, assign the next iteration with actual planned work, using active_iterations. Add later iterations before planning work beyond the third. Do not automatically carry a waiting card through weeks with zero work.
Iteration values can be changed at review while preserving Start date, Target date, Estimate, Plan and native dependencies unless an explicit replan is required.
A current-sprint sum of full Estimate is not sprint effort for multiweek cards; read the per-iteration hours table instead. No duplicated phase Estimate.

cycles.title: Итерация 3

cycles.title: Итерация 4
cycles.goal: Завершить обязательные функции, пройти проверки и запустить MVP 9 декабря.

cycles.title: Итерация 5
cycles.goal: Разобрать обратную связь, устранить обнаруженные проблемы в пределах резерва и подготовить итоговые материалы.
